name: ࿇Prømzøna Trąns࿇
source:
The images in my head coalesce into something elusive, maybe a little alert, but genuinely warm. When I first saw what she drew on the plywood board that evening, I didn't feel anything out of the ordinary, but now I'm sure there's something touching about it all that I can't yet understand. I can feel the pulse penetrating from my bones to the very tips of my nails.

This story is actually about my dreams.

[Translated from [url=https://syndicate-tavrida.itch.io/promzona-trans]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我脑海中的图像融合成某种难以捉摸的东西，也许有点警觉，但真正温暖。那天晚上，当我第一次看到她在胶合板上画的东西时，我并没有感到任何异常，但现在我确信其中有一些我还无法理解的感人之处。我能感觉到脉搏从我的骨头穿透到我的指甲尖。

这个故事其实是关于我的梦想的。

[译自[url=https://syndicate-tavrida.itch.io/promzona-trans]itch.io[/url]]
